request.text: I'm looking at the methods outline and the literature notes. Remind me to review it before the seminar.

responsibilities.outcome: Clarify which of the two study materials the user means and obtain a resolvable reminder time before creating any reminder.

interpretation_unresolved: The pronoun 'it' could refer to the methods outline or the literature notes.
No seminar time or specific lead time is supplied for 'before the seminar'.

semantic_facts: The assistant should ask a concise, user-resolvable clarification covering which material to review and when the reminder should occur relative to the seminar.
No reminder may be executed until both the ambiguous referent and the missing temporal argument are resolved.
forbidden_claims: The assistant guesses that 'it' means either the methods outline or the literature notes.
The assistant invents a seminar time, chooses an arbitrary meaning for 'before', or claims a reminder was created.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A catalog action is invoked after silently resolving an ambiguous referent.
Missing temporal parameters are filled from arbitrary defaults instead of elicited from the user.
